description: A comprehensive CRM platform providing APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for managing customer data, marketing, sales, and AI integrations.
api_breadth: Extensive capabilities covering CRM objects (contacts, companies, deals, tickets), marketing content, custom objects, analytics, conversations, and AI tool integrations through Model Context Protocol (MCP).
mcp_evidence: HubSpot provides two distinct Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers: a remote HubSpot MCP Server for connecting LLMs to CRM data via https://mcp.hubspot.com, and a local Developer MCP Server.
blocker: OAuth flows require proper implementation of PKCE for MCP connections and handling token expiration/refresh token rotation.
